entries.source: Scuba Diving in Alanya. Guided Mediterranean diving experience with a planned three-dive depth program, professional instruction, equipment and yacht program. Actual dive count, depth and route depend on instructor approval. From €35.
entries.translation: Scuba Diving in Alanya. Guided Mediterranean diving experience with a planned three-dive depth program, professional instruction, equipment and yacht program. Actual dive count, depth and route depend on instructor approval. From €35.

entries.source: Discover the Mediterranean underwater world with professional instruction and a yacht day
entries.translation: Discover the Mediterranean underwater world with professional instruction and a yacht day

entries.source: Join a guided diving day in Alanya with professional instruction, diving equipment and time on board. The number, duration and depth of dives depend on experience, certification, health screening and instructor approval.
entries.translation: Join a guided diving day in Alanya with professional instruction, diving equipment and time on board. The number, duration and depth of dives depend on experience, certification, health screening and instructor approval.

entries.source: Scuba Diving in Alanya is a guided yacht-based diving experience with separate arrangements for beginners and certified divers.
entries.translation: Scuba Diving in Alanya is a guided yacht-based diving experience with separate arrangements for beginners and certified divers.

entries.source: First-time participants receive a briefing, equipment introduction and shallow-water skills practice before any open-water dive. They remain under direct professional supervision.
entries.translation: First-time participants receive a briefing, equipment introduction and shallow-water skills practice before any open-water dive. They remain under direct professional supervision.

entries.source: Certified divers may follow a different plan based on certification level, recent dive history, equipment, sea conditions and the dive professional’s approval.
entries.translation: Certified divers may follow a different plan based on certification level, recent dive history, equipment, sea conditions and the dive professional’s approval.

entries.source: The standard program is planned as three progressive dives at approximately 3–6 m, 7–9 m and 10–12 m. The actual number of dives, depth and underwater route depend on certification, health screening, participant readiness, sea conditions and the instructor’s final decision.
entries.translation: The standard program is planned as three progressive dives at approximately 3–6 m, 7–9 m and 10–12 m. The actual number of dives, depth and underwater route depend on certification, health screening, participant readiness, sea conditions and the instructor’s final decision.

entries.source: The standard program is planned as three progressive dives at approximately 3–6 m, 7–9 m and 10–12 m. The instructor may reduce the number or depth of dives, or change the route, based on certification, health, readiness and sea conditions.

entries.source: The planned depth scheme is approximately 3–6 m for the first dive, 7–9 m for the second and 10–12 m for the third. These depths are not automatic: the instructor determines the actual depth for each participant.
entries.translation: The planned depth scheme is approximately 3–6 m for the first dive, 7–9 m for the second and 10–12 m for the third. These depths are not automatic: the instructor determines the actual depth for each participant.

entries.source: No. Participants complete a health questionnaire, and some answers require medical clearance. Pregnancy, intoxication and certain medical conditions prevent participation.
